column3: Close to the Hebrew; “sing the glory of his name” is rendered “Sing out the honor of His name.”
Close to the Hebrew; יְכַחֲשׁוּ (“cringe”) is rendered “shall submit themselves.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who set our soul in life” is rendered “Who keeps our soul among the living.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְמָתְנֵינוּ (“on our loins”) is rendered “on our backs.”
Close to the Hebrew; לָרְוָיָה (“to abundance”) is rendered “to rich fulfillment.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the smoke of rams” is rendered “the sweet aroma of rams.”
Close to the Hebrew; “exaltation was under my tongue” is rendered “He was extolled with my tongue.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “mercy.”
